title: Absorb a pulled term sheet
summary: Start with facts. Get the real reason if you can; a fixable diligence finding is different from partner politics or a turning market. Check what you signed. Term sheets are mostly non-binding except exclusivity/no-shop and confidentiality, so note when the no-shop expires before re-opening conversations (the NVCA model documents show the standard shape). Re-run the runway math on real numbers. Then pick a path: re-open the process wide, bridge with insiders on SAFEs (YC's published documents are the standard), or cut to default-alive. Tell the waiting investors the truth: the round changed, the company did not. If cash is the issue, start the cost plan now; the weeks in denial are the expensive ones. Editorial guidance from the standard documents; nothing here is legal or financial advice.
